ascii_only: Names are plain ASCII so the shared tokenizer and search treat them predictably.
purpose: What Python picks before any model call so that each run starts somewhere different. Everything here is abstract: shapes, pressures and textures, never plots. A user brief overrides any seed it touches; seeds fill only the gaps.

mechanisms.text: substitution of one routine object for another
an effect set up earlier that takes hold later
a legitimate procedure used for an illegitimate end
a record altered or completed after the fact
a delivery or message sent to the wrong place, on purpose or not
an ordinary physical condition exploited: heat, cold, damp, weight, noise
a scene arranged to look routine
a timed absence that others cover without knowing why
blame moved onto someone else through paperwork
an instruction misread, then the misreading protected

red_herrings.text: a hidden debt or money trouble
a minor rule broken for a decent reason
protecting a family member from consequences
a health condition kept from the employer
a quiet plan to leave for another post
taking back credit for work that was taken from them
an old mistake of their own, long covered
unofficial side work or an arrangement outside the rules
a grievance they are documenting in secret
caring duties hidden from the institution

stakes.text: frailty: a body or mind failing, and the fear of it being seen
institutional hubris: a place that cannot admit it was wrong
uncredited labour: work that held things together and was never acknowledged
protective loyalty: covering for someone at a cost to oneself
a promise made to someone who is gone
a small place's reputation and the people who carry it
a duty inherited and never chosen

human_questions.text: What do we owe the people whose work we use?
When does protecting someone become harming them?
Who is allowed to be tired?
What does an institution remember, and what does it choose to forget?
Is a correct record an honest one?
What is a person worth once they can no longer do the job?
How long can a kindness be kept secret before it becomes a lie?
What happens to loyalty when the thing you are loyal to does not deserve it?
Can you be responsible for something you did not intend?

ironies.text: The most careful person made the decisive mistake.
The official record is accurate and still misleading.
The accused is protecting the accuser.
The culprit filed the decisive evidence themselves, correctly.
The person nobody noticed noticed everything.
